name: Florian Ronsse
bio: Every group needs someone with a plan, and in ours that is Florian. A Disney fan for almost as long as he can remember, he knows the magic is in the details: park days, cruise itineraries, Lightning Lane strategy and the late-night snack runs. Our story started with him and Tibeau. They used to be colleagues, and through their friendship the five of us found each other.

notes.label: Disney fan
notes.value: For almost as long as he can remember

notes.label: Fun fact
notes.value: He and Tibeau were colleagues. That friendship is how the crew came together.

name: Megan
bio: A food lover at heart: new dishes, new flavours and an honest opinion on all of them, with a good cocktail alongside. She works in hospitality herself, so she knows the effort behind a good experience and always shows her appreciation to the staff. She is one of the most caring people in the group and makes sure nobody is left behind. If something does not meet her expectations, her face says it all: the famous bombastic side-eye.

notes.label: On a cruise
notes.value: A good book, the pool, spreading Pixie Dust, or our quiz and crafting sessions

name: Elias
bio: Always up for the next adventure, whether that is another attraction, an activity on a Disney Cruise or something new to discover. His enthusiasm is contagious. He is also our own Disney encyclopedia, with a fun fact up his sleeve for details most people would never notice. And like Tibeau, he will not say no to a nice aperitif.

notes.label: Perfect Disney day
notes.value: Trying everything, discovering something new and sharing plenty of fun facts

name: Lotte
bio: Energetic and a little clumsy in the best way. Lotte is obsessed with Frozen, loves pixie dust, and is usually the first one to suggest one more snack or one more ride.

name: Tibeau
bio: The calm one, who takes things at his own pace. While some of us love exploring theme parks, Tibeau is happiest on a Disney Cruise, especially on a sea day with nothing to do but enjoy the ocean view. He is always up for a cocktail or an aperitif, and by the end of a cruise he is friends with almost every bartender on board.

notes.label: Happiest
notes.value: On a sea day, with ocean views and nowhere else to be

notes.label: Known for
notes.value: Being friends with almost every bartender on board by the end of the cruise

notes.label: Perfect Disney day
notes.value: Not necessarily an attraction. Sometimes a sea day and a good drink.
